title: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:63 - CDDL schema covers binary fields incorrectly
description: The CDDL schema at lines 63-78 defines the entire beacon as a CBOR map with typed fields (epoch, num_slots, etc.), but the byte layout table at lines 43-59 shows these as fixed binary fields with only offset 24+ being CBOR (cbor_options). The CDDL incorrectly includes fixed binary header fields as if they were CBOR-encoded, which will cause interop failures if implementers follow the CDDL literally.
close_reason: Fixed CDDL schema to only cover CBOR options tail (offset 24+). Removed fixed binary header fields (epoch, num_slots, sfn, etc.) that are NOT CBOR-encoded. Added clarifying text and included slot_map and pow_challenge in the schema.
